[[File:Loor.jpg|thumb|220px|Imperial Liaison Kirtan Loor]]
{{Quote|Your Imperial Liaison is quite the deductive genius."<br />"He doesn't get out much.|Wes Janson and Corran Horn on Kirtan Loor|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 26">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 26|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 26]]</ref>}}
'''Imperial Liaisons''' were [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] assigned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to work in tandem with local [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] government agencies. Their purpose was to advise their local counterparts instead of just giving orders, although this guideline was not followed by all these envoys.<ref name="GG4a">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

In the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], the activities of the [[Corellian Security Force]] were highly supervised by the Empire during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] officers were inserted in all CorSec divisions to monitor and coordinate operations with local Imperial garrisons.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|143|Corellian Security Force (CorSec)}}</ref> [[Kirtan Loor]] served in such a position in [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn's]] [[Smuggling Interdiction Division|division]].<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Imperial Intelligence liaisons were also assigned to the CorSec [[Fourth Batallion]]<ref name="SWG:TGHHQ">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Training Ground Has Hostile Quadrupeds}} on Corellia</ref> and to the [[224th Recon Patrol Squad]].<ref name="SWG:RRBFA">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Rescue Recon Buddy From Animals}} on Corellia</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Giiedt]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Demmings]] in turn were liaison officers for the [[Tiss'sharl League/Legends|Tiss'sharl League]] on [[Tiss'sharl/Legends|Tiss'sharl]],<ref name="Empire_31">[[Empire 31|''Empire'' 31]]</ref> while [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pandur]] was a liaison officer to [[Korfo II/Legends|Korfo II]].<ref name="GG4a" />
